title: TD2 Comms: True Sons
summary: A collection of 10 comms from The Division universe, scraped from the Fandom wiki hub page. 10 entries include full audio transcripts; 10 have known map locations.

claims.text: Comm "Relocation Order": Ridgeway gives orders to his men to move refugees to Roosevelt Island (Location: East Mall (980, 4412))
Comm "Roosevelt Supplies": Ridgeway orders his medic to cut their losses and stockpile supplies intended to treat the sick (Location: Foggy Bottom (2037, 1312))
Comm "Ridgeway Sentencing": Ridgeway is sentenced for his crimes against civilians and refugees (Location: East Mall (1056, 4515))
Comm "Negotiations": Antwon Ridgeway refuses to negotiate (Location: Federal Triangle (1373, 3605))
Comm "Weaponized DC-62": Captain Wilson and Ridgeway discuss potential applications of DC-62 (Location: Southwest (527, 3773))
Comm "The Castle": Ridgeway makes the call to bomb the Castle settlement (Location: East Mall (973, 3593))
Comm "Death and Taxes": Ridgeway personally visits a small civilian community who has not been paying their taxes (Location: East Mall (1138, 3903))
Comm "Fortifications": True Sons discuss the progress on building fortifications (Location: East Mall (1042, 3740))
Comm "Close Encounter": A True Sons soldier talks to Ridgeway about a close encounter with Outcasts (Location: East Mall (948, 3953))
Comm "Acceptable Losses": Ridgeway meets with an advisor to formulate a plan to maintain control of DC, after losing several battles to Division agents (Location: Southwest (615, 4164))
